action_items: Pre-existing test tests/test_tscheck_documents.py::test_document_addition_returns_reviewed_applicant_evidence uses a static fixture title (tscheck-journey-evidence.pdf) instead of a unique suffix, so it fails on any rerun once residue exists (observed 2/3 matches). This predates this iteration's acceptance_matrix (no document criterion in this briefing) and is not a regression from the live-agent feature; flagged for cleanup but not blocking this iteration.

Backend logs show a transient litellm.AuthenticationError from an older/rotated API key on some earlier request; current live calls (via curl and the new pytest file) succeed consistently against the configured AICredits/gpt-5.4 provider, so this is not currently reproducible.
